name: m4-devirt-tip-ab
description: Timing A/B of the whole of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199): final `Symbol` predicates, `info`, `rawInfo`, `owner`, `typeOfThis`, `tpe_*`, and the `TypeMap` / `typeParams` fast paths, against its base. The profile campaigns showed the targeted stubs gone, but their totals are within fork-to-fork noise (1.4% in cycles for identical code). The earlier 5-round A/B of step 1 was too wide (±6.3%), so this runs 20 rounds on the scala corpus.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, no profiler.
